description: Report a domain's resolution and mail-authentication records in one call: A, AAAA, MX, SPF and DMARC, each labelled present, absent or unreadable, with the DNS-over-HTTPS resolver that answered. 'Absent' is a definite answer from the resolver; 'unreadable' is not evidence of absence, and the two are never merged. Choose this to qualify a domain before you trust it or mail it: A, AAAA, MX, SPF and DMARC in one call, each labelled present, absent or unreadable with the resolver that answered. Do not choose this as a full deliverability or reputation test: DKIM selectors are not enumerated, blocklist status is not checked, and 'unreadable' is not evidence that a record is missing. Example requests: Does swishrjobs.com publish SPF and DMARC, and can it receive mail? | Check whether this domain resolves and has email authentication set up. | Is example.com's email authenticated, or does it have no DMARC record?

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

domain.description: The domain to check, such as 'example.com'. A URL is accepted and reduced to its host.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.
